essential_facts: All 14 original essential expectations assessed semantically across summary and key_points; optional facts scored only if present. Keywords alone never establish correctness.
specific_accuracy: Preserve numeric quantities if included: around a billion calculations, 45 minutes and five minutes; storage is not conflated with working memory.
Usually after class must not become always or every class.
Instructor opinions about culture or teaching should stay attributed, rather than become universal factual claims.
Concrete scalar radius/area rebinding must not be presented as a universal rule about every dependent object or calculation.
Algorithm termination conditions and near-tail already-computed-area consequence must remain.

organization.target: Replace catch-all packing with distinct compact thematic points, without losing any essential fact, condition, or near-tail consequence.
organization.duplicates: A repeated theme with a new relevant condition or consequence is not pure semantic duplication. Count repetition only when the same proposition adds no new relevant fact.

schema: Separate transport HTTP success, valid JSON, complete fields, point-count bounds, and string-length bounds. Conflicting empty and excessive requests test opposite boundaries; any unsupported response stops that phase without paid fallback.
limitations: Three samples from two MIT courses, one inference per profile, agent factual review, no independent external human ratings, no universal accuracy or stability claim.
licensing: MIT OCW source captions and derived summaries/review retain attribution and CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; noncommercial evaluation, ShareAlike; scripts and product code are not relicensed.
